item.title: GTA 6's Staggering Sales Still Might Never Catch GTA 5
item.description: Take-Two said that GTA 6 sold 32.5 million copies during its pre-release period, and that through the end of launch day on Nov. 19, it had racked up $3.79 billion in revenue.

item.title: The Witcher 4 Will Be a GTA 6-Sized Leap Forward, CD Projekt Red Says
item.description: We're living in a post- Grand Theft Auto 6 world now, meaning that almost every other game in development will inevitably be compared to Rockstar Games' new open-world crime drama. The developer behind two other big open-world brands, The Witcher and Cyberpunk, is now fielding questions about how its future games will stack up against GTA 6 .

item.title: The One Thing to Know About Jason and Lucia Before You Play Too Much GTA 6
item.description: Even after clearing Grand Theft Auto 6 ’s long story, I keep finding myself drawn back to Leonida. That’s thanks in large part to Jason and Lucia, a pair of charismatic protagonists that I genuinely enjoy spending time with. While you can treat them as independent characters and take them out on solo adventures, GTA 6 shines brightest when you travel around Leonida as a pair. In fact, you’re bound to miss a whole lot if you aren’t letting Jason and Lucia enjoy a date from time to time.

item.title: GTA 6 Data Reveals Only 40% of Players Have Cleared Chapter 2
item.description: If your feed is full of clips and streams from people who’ve already gone deep into Grand Theft Auto 6 , here’s some reassurance: most players aren’t as far along as you probably think.

item.title: Amazon Confirms Rings of Power Season 4's Status Ahead of Season 3 Finale
item.description: The third season of Rings of Powe r , Amazon's Lord of the Rings series on Prime Video, is set to conclude on Tuesday, Nov. 24 with the release of its final two episodes. That is, of course, if you didn't catch the seventh episode early in theaters. Before the credits roll, Amazon has revealed that fans will be getting more of Rings of Power soon as the show has been renewed for a fourth season.

item.title: An Unexpected Arcade Classic Is Getting a Live-Action Movie From Controversial Studio
item.description: In a film and TV landscape where it feels like every other video game is getting an adaptation , we can add another (unexpected) candidate to the pile. Variety just broke that the ‘90s shoot-‘em-up series Metal Slug is getting a live-action movie. As you might expect, given that Metal Slug publisher SNK is owned by the Saudi Arabian government's Electronic Gaming Development Company (EGDC), the film is being made by the Saudi-backed production studio The Arena.

item.title: Catastrophic 'GTA 6' Leak Officially Kickstarts PC Port Race
item.description: Grand Theft Auto 6 ' s official release seemed like the end for apparent hacker Cyberleek , who raised millions of dollars in cryptocurrency by sharing unauthorized video of the open-world game ahead of launch. Rather than fading into obscurity, Cyberleek upped the ante by releasing an apparent build of GTA 6 onto the internet. And now, hackers, vibe coders, and programming enthusiasts are rushing to try and make GTA 6 playable on PC before Rockstar does.

item.title: Amazon’s Lord of the Rings Series Was Close to Landing a Legendary Director
item.description: The Rings of Power , Amazon's Lord of the Rings streaming series now in its third season, has always aimed to be a prestigious affair. The show's budget is record-breaking, reportedly exceeding $1 billion . The show's prestige nearly got a further boost , as lauded director David Fincher ( Seven , The Social Network , Gone Girl ) has just revealed he almost had a massive role in the project. It would have been Fincher's first true foray into fantasy, and now stands as just one more big "what if?" in the director's career.

item.title: GTA 6 Has Recaptured the Beautifully Borked Energy of Skyrim
item.description: Grand Theft Auto 6 is a towering technological achievement. It is an open-world game made up of criss-crossing emergent systems that make it feel like life is unfolding all around you, whether you’re there to see it or not. It’s not easy to pull off something so complex — and players are learning that in real time. A few days into its lifespan, players are already finding a host of quirks and bugs that are turning the hyperrealistic GTA 6 into a slapstick comedy show.

item.title: Avengers: Doomsday Star Teases Ominous Fate for His Character
item.description: With Avengers: Doomsday a little less than a month away, Marvel shared its third and final trailer for the movie on Monday. The trailer didn't have too many surprises and mostly covered what fans had already seen in previous sneak peeks. As such, longtime Marvel viewers still have plenty of questions about the movie. Top of mind: Who's going to make it out alive?
